refinementBoundary: This initial stage probe predates the final PM review that made Back home the processing-day primary, added compact header sound access and reduced explicit ready Watch to one click. Final styled snapshots and ready-context proof record those subsequent presentation refinements. The operation/authority, purse, expiry and scroll assertions remain separately scoped here.
harnessRecovery: The initial all-stage sequence reached every pending/purse/scroll assertion, then waited for a controlled wallet callback while two wallet choices were visible. It had not selected the uniquely named controlled provider. The focused corrected wallet probe explicitly selected Journey QA hold, received only eth_requestAccounts, and cancelled before any signing. No app-source change was needed for this tooling recovery.
